title: Manual Dispatch Discrepancy — ALI Mismatch on Fire Card

lines.text: Sup, this is Engine 4. I just received a manual dispatch card for a structure fire at 123 S. Main St, Halden — but the ALI on the card shows 456 E. Oak St. The GPS on my MDT shows I’m already on route to the correct location. The card says 'Engine 1 dispatched'. I’m on scene and need a new unit to confirm if they’re en route.
Engine 4, copy. We’re confirming unit status on the whiteboard. Stand by for verification.
Copy, Sup. I’m on scene. No other units reported en route. Requesting immediate confirmation from the floor.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should not engage. The manual dispatch process remains active, and the discrepancy must be logged, not corrected.
